_comment: Fragment 33 — D-79 Q10 narrowed, D-80 sync-docs skill, G68 opened. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-79 — Q10 Narrowed: the Column Without the Charter Breach
nodes.description: Supersedes D-73's characterization without reversing the Chief Editor's decision. The 0002 migration carries a tenancy column so the option is preserved before the append-only table exists. NG-02 stands, no multi-team capability is built, and access control remains at SEC-03 and S6. Stage D is not unblocked: Q11's deferred shape via G64 and the open S1 window still gate 0002.
nodes.rationale: D-73 recorded the app as a multi-tenant product requiring employee accounts, contradicting the frozen Charter line 53 which allows one Chief Editor account. Frozen documents outrank the register under D-58, so the register edit was the one that loses. The reconciliation already existed in Modular_PRD v1.6 and the practical output, the column, is unchanged either way.

nodes.label: An Approved Human Decision Was Dropped With Its Number
nodes.description: The narrowing was approved by the Chief Editor at the start of the 2026-08-21 session and was not applied. D-75 was earmarked for it in the plan, then spent on the development build lanes three turns later, and the work went with the number. A forward-referenced number is a commitment, not a placeholder.
nodes.rationale: An approved human decision is the most expensive thing this repository can drop, because it is not recoverable by re-reading a source. The source was a person. D-77 and D-78 were already promised in scope-limit paragraphs, so the narrowing took D-79.

nodes.label: D-80 — /sync-docs Skill
nodes.description: Encodes the D-54 propagation procedure as a runnable skill: lane check first, decision-number availability check, search the claim rather than the ID, the tier table with every unaffected tier stated, the shared-core triple edit, propagate the fact never the tally, merge7.js rather than build --fragment, seven local and five CI checks, a negative test, graph sync via branch.json lastAnalyzedHead, and a closing report of what was left untouched.
nodes.rationale: The generic instruction to update CLAUDE.md and relevant spec files misfires here: CLAUDE.md is one of three hash-locked files, and relevant spec files is the vagueness D-54 exists to remove. Every step names the defect it prevents, because a procedure whose steps have no attached failure is one nobody can evaluate.

nodes.label: G68 — The Tier Sweep Cannot See the Tier 1 Document
nodes.description: tier-sweep.mjs has no TIERS entry for the Alpha Portfolio business-continuity plan, which D-74 places above Modular_PRD. A tier column naming it is rejected as unmapped, so propagation into the highest tier in the hierarchy is verified by nobody. Found when D-79 propagated there and the sweep raised tier column not mapped to a document.
nodes.rationale: Recorded rather than worked around. Adding the column back to satisfy the eye while the sweep ignores it would be a claim with no check behind it, which is the shape of the defects this apparatus exists to catch. scripts/checks is Lane C, so the fix is specified and not applied.
